My plot is small, only a bit more than a third of a hectare, and maize is what feeds my family. I went to school for some years so I know fertilizer helps, but cash is tight here in Mwanza — if I get a FISP coupon I will buy one bag of NPK and one bag of urea, otherwise I can only afford maybe one bag total and I split it carefully. I plant hybrid seed when I can get it through the subsidy, and I put the manure from my few chickens and goats on the plot before the rains. I intercrop with pigeon pea and beans, so my wife and I do most of the weeding ourselves — I only hire a few people for the first weeding if the rains come heavy and the weeds run ahead of me.
